title: Donut-shaped UFOs above Rossi's old house

tellings.quote: my old house there were there were a few that would be above it above the house.

plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says beings taught him advanced physics, tells Michels that donut-shaped UFOs used to hover over his old house: "there were a few that would be above it." He brings his father into the story, without a date or details of what either of them saw.
